title: Phase 121 publishes 68 priority research missions
summary: Every Phase 116 priority question now has a public mission packet with exact evidence requirements, research design, named project and place joins, Candidate acquisition packets, contextual Published evidence, acceptance and rejection rules, and a visible stop state.
evidence_note: The missions preserve the exact Phase 116 question contracts and use Phase 118 evidence only as contextual background. They create no answer, source fact, artifact admission, gate decision, observation, outcome, score, ranking, or upstream record-state change.
publication_effect: Publishes 69 bounded HTML routes and one machine-readable mission registry without adjudicating any research answer.
